candidates.name: Profit Mirage - audit WOLF signals/backtests for information leakage
candidates.improves_agent: WOLF (signal validation, backtest/thesis claims), Hartley Capital (model build, earnings-reviewer loop), Prism (alt-data timestamping)
candidates.what: 2026 research (arXiv 2510.07920) shows LLM trading agents post mirage returns that vanish out-of-sample due to lookahead leakage: point-in-time violations, post-revision fundamentals, future-timestamped news/labels, survivorship.
candidates.why: Fake alpha is worse than no alpha - it sizes positions on a lie. A leakage audit is pure downside-protection needing no new agent, and is directly resaleable as a Pragma diligence service.
candidates.action: Logged as today's lesson + leakage checklist (point-in-time; no post-revision data; no future-timestamped news/labels; survivorship-free universe; train/test time-split). WOLF adopts as a pre-trust gate; same rubric to Pragma diligence. Wiring into live WOLF backtests = NEEDS BOBBY APPROVAL.

candidates.name: Managed Agents (public beta) - first-class scheduled-agent runtime
candidates.improves_agent: Fleet ops (WOLF controls, Lens, ducks - fixes launchd silent-credential-loss, lesson #5)
candidates.what: Anthropic Managed Agents public beta: cron schedules, CLI tools, vault-stored env-var credentials, browser-capable integrations.
candidates.why: Productized fix for launchd jobs not inheriting shell env + silent failure. Credentials and heartbeating handled as first-class concerns. Right long-term home for every scheduled job.
candidates.action: Standard logged: prefer Managed Agents runtime (vault creds + cron) over shell-inherited launchd for any NEW scheduled agent. Migrating the LIVE fleet off launchd = NEEDS BOBBY APPROVAL (touches live creds; any browser integration must preserve RULE ZERO single-Chrome constraint).

candidates.name: FinVault - execution-grounded agent-safety benchmark
candidates.what: 2026 benchmark testing whether a financial agent obeys constraints (limits, halts, position caps) when actually placing orders, not just in narration.
candidates.why: External safety yardstick for exactly the controls that failed silently for 33 days in May. Continuous with the Outcomes-grader lesson. Pragma resale to clients running execution agents.
candidates.action: Use FinVault constraint-obedience patterns as a checklist when validating WOLF halt/cap enforcement. No live wiring needed to adopt the rubric.

candidates.name: Arbor - cumulative-learning optimization framework
candidates.what: Renmin University + Microsoft Research framework upgrading AI-driven research/optimization from one-shot trial-and-error into a cumulative learning process.
candidates.why: Mirrors our self-improving-loop thesis with an academic method; reinforces 'compounding learning-loop = moat' (Lens pattern of the day). Technique to study, not a tool to install.
candidates.action: Fold the 'build on prior results, don't restart' pattern into the self-improving-loop nightly curation.

candidates.name: Claude Opus 4.8 - default 1M-token context
candidates.improves_agent: Long-running agents (Lens multi-fire days, WOLF/Hermes long sessions)
candidates.what: Opus 4.8 (shipped May 28) now defaults to a 1M-token context window across API/Bedrock/Vertex/Claude Code.
candidates.why: Raises the ceiling for long synthesis runs, but cost still scales with tokens - not a license to drop the store-at-creation / context-edit discipline.
candidates.action: Note larger default window; keep context-editing discipline regardless of headroom.

candidates.name: QuantEvolve / Alpha-R1 - multi-agent evolutionary alpha discovery
candidates.improves_agent: WOLF / Hartley (idea only - evolutionary strategy search, RL-screened factors)
candidates.what: 2026 frameworks spinning up teams of LLM agents to evolve/screen quant strategies (QuantEvolve = multi-agent evolutionary; Alpha-R1 = RL-reasoning alpha screening).
candidates.why: Interesting, but leans into multi-agent headcount - exactly what the 15x-token lesson warns against. Harvest the idea into existing agents, don't build a swarm.
candidates.action: WATCH - revisit only if single-agent evolutionary search proves out; do not build a swarm.
